description: Unit test class for the ModifyResource class, testing its immutability, equality, null handling, JSON conversion, and instantiation from JSON.

classes.name: ModifyResourceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ModifyResource functionality, immutability, JSON serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ModifyResource class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyResource instance with null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyResource instance with null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that passing null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullResource
methods.description: Ensures that passing null resource throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ModifyResource instance from a valid JSON string and verifies its contents.
